description: This Java class 'InvoiceWorker' contains utility methods for handling invoice calculations, including totals, tax computations, address retrieval, and currency conversions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: InvoiceWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for invoice calculations and data retrieval within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getInvoiceTotal
methods.description: Calculates total invoice amount including tax, with optional currency conversion.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemTotal
methods.description: Calculates total for an invoice item (quantity * amount).

methods.name: getInvoiceItemDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for an invoice item, resolving product or tax details.

methods.name: getTaxableInvoiceItemTypeIds
methods.description: Retrieves list of invoice item type IDs that are taxable.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates total tax amount for an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceNoTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates invoice total excluding tax.

methods.name: getBillToParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party associated with the invoice's bill-to role.

methods.name: getBillFromParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party who is the bill-from on the invoice.

methods.name: getSendFromParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party who is the sender of the invoice.

methods.name: getShippingAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping address related to the invoice.

methods.name: getBillToAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the billing address for the invoice.

methods.name: getSendFromAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the sender's address for the invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceAddressByType
methods.description: Retrieves an address of a specific contactMechPurposeTypeId for the invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the amount of invoice not yet applied to payments.

methods.name: getInvoiceApplied
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of the invoice that has been applied to payments.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemApplied
methods.description: Calculates the amount of an invoice item that has been applied to payments.

methods.name: getInvoiceCurrencyConversionRate
methods.description: Retrieves the currency conversion rate for an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxByTaxAuthGeoAndParty
methods.description: Deprecated. Returns tax breakdown by tax authority geo and party.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxAuthPartyAndGeos
methods.description: Returns a map of tax authority parties and their associated geos for an invoice.

methods.name: getInvoiceTaxTotalForTaxAuthPartyAndGeo
methods.description: Calculates total tax for a specific tax authority party and geo.

methods.name: getInvoiceUnattributedTaxTotal
methods.description: Calculates total tax for tax items without a tax authority party.
